title: Russia Moves to Tamp Down Rumors About Plague Outbreak in Siberia
summary_full: The country’s consumer watchdog has said only that “an employee of an anti-plague institute in the Irkutsk Region” contracted pneumonia. Rumors and unconfirmed reports sounded a more ominous note.
